meta.name: Extract invoice data from Google Drive PDFs with Mistral OCR and Sheets

parameters.content:
## Automatic Invoice Processing

### How it works

This workflow monitors a Google Drive folder for new invoice files, downloads each file, extracts text/data, parses invoice fields with JavaScript, appends the results to Google Sheets, and then moves the processed file. A separate lower canvas branch uploads a file to Mistral, retrieves a signed URL, and requests OCR results, likely intended to support invoice text extraction. The canvas is arranged as a left-to-right processing pipeline with a distinct OCR API helper cluster below it.

### Setup steps

- Connect Google Drive credentials for the trigger, file download, and file move nodes.
- Configure the Google Drive trigger folder, the download file reference, and the destination folder used by the Move file node.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials and select the target spreadsheet, sheet, and column mappings for appended invoice rows.
- Configure Mistral API authentication for the HTTP Request nodes, including the bearer token/API key and any required request headers.
- Review the Code: Extract Fields JavaScript so it matches the invoice formats and the fields expected by the Google Sheet.

### Customization

Customize the field extraction logic, sheet columns, watched Drive folder, processed-file destination, and OCR provider settings to match different invoice layouts or document sources.

## Detect and download files

Watches Google Drive for newly added invoice files and downloads the detected file so it can be processed by the workflow.

## Extract invoice fields

Extracts content from the downloaded file and runs custom JavaScript to convert the raw extracted data into structured invoice fields.

## Record and archive invoice

Adds the parsed invoice data to a Google Sheet, then moves the original file in Google Drive to mark it as processed.

## Run Mistral OCR

A separate lower cluster that uploads a file to Mistral, obtains a signed file URL, and submits it for OCR processing.
